footnote_text: Received in exchange for shares of common stock of Prana Therapies, Inc. ("Prana") pursuant to the Agreement and Plan of Merger dated October 23, 2026 (the "Merger Agreement") by and among the Issuer, Prana, Prince Merger Sub I, Inc., a Delaware corporation and a wholly owned subsidiary of the Issuer ("Merger Sub I"), Prince Merger Sub II, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company and wholly owned subsidiary of the Issuer ("Merger Sub II"). Each outstanding share of Prana common stock was converted into the right to receive 1.6413 shares of the Issuer's common stock or common-stock equivalents, consisting of Issuer's common stock and Series D Convertible Preferred Stock ("Series D Preferred") convertible at a rate of 1,000 shares of Issuer's common stock per share of Series D Preferred. No cash purchase price was paid for the Series D Preferred received as merger consideration. || Upon closing of the merger on October 23, 2026, Prana shares held directly by the Reporting Person converted into 72,766 shares of Issuer's common stock and 2,763.833 shares of Series D Preferred. Prana shares held by SilverArc Private Fund I, L.P. converted into 13,055 shares of Issuer's common stock and 495.874 shares of Series D Preferred.  The 495.874 shares of Series D Preferred constitute merger consideration
